## 📋 Description
Provide a concise explanation of the changes made and the motivation behind them.

## 🔗 Related Issue
Closes #<!-- Insert issue number here, e.g. Closes #12 -->

## 🛠️ Type of Change
- [ ] `feat`: New feature or user capability
- [ ] `fix`: Bug fix
- [ ] `docs`: Documentation updates
- [ ] `chore`: Maintenance, dependencies, or build tool update
- [ ] `test`: New or updated tests
- [ ] `refactor`: Refactoring without behavior change
- [ ] `ci`: Pipeline or workflow modifications

## ✅ Pull Request Checklist
Please verify the following criteria before requesting review:
- [ ] **Linked Issue**: The PR references the corresponding issue number above.
- [ ] **Builds with Maven**: Project compiles successfully (`./mvnw clean package`).
- [ ] **Tests Pass**: All unit and integration tests pass without failures (`./mvnw test`).
- [ ] **Acceptance Criteria Met**: All acceptance criteria outlined in the issue have been verified.
- [ ] **README / Documentation Updated**: Any relevant technical docs, `README.md`, or architecture notes are up to date.
- [ ] **No Secrets**: Verified that no credentials, tokens, or private secrets are committed.
